_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.src: Return to Korzim on the second floor of the enchanter in {p} with the Amulet of Fire Resistance and the Staff of True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.dst: Вернись к Korzim на второй этаж дома чародейки в {p} с Amulet of Fire Resistance и Staff of True Ice.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#001.src: ...Do you have...the staff? And the amulet...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#001.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#002.src: The war is starting... and Axelus... He has not returned.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#002.dst: Война начинается… а Axelus… Он не вернулся.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#002.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.src: We can not go... Not without him. Find him... And bring him to the... Dogun village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.dst: Мы не можем уйти… Не без него. Найди его… И приведи в… деревню Dogun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#004.src: I can not leave. The guard...it is on high alert. He was last at {p}...yes?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#004.dst: Мне не уйти. Стража… начеку. Он был последний раз в {p}… да?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#004.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.src: Head to {p} and look for Axelus.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.src: The first group has already started their climb, let's hurry.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.dst: Первая группа уже начала подъём, поторопимся.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.speaker: Soldier

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.src: Hey! Everyone, the king has someone in the cage! It's been years since we used it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.dst: Эй! Все сюда, король кого-то запер в клетке! Её не использовали много лет!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#008.src: Wait, that's Axelus up there!! The king locked up his son?! What in the world?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#008.dst: Постой, там же Axelus!! Король запер сына?! Да что творится?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#008.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.src: I heard he was consorting with demons, but that can't possibly be true, can it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.dst: Говорят, он якшался с демонами, но это же не может быть правдой?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.src: For the last time, they are not demons!! Gods, I've been telling you this whole time! Not even my father will listen to reason!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.dst: Последний раз говорю: они не демоны!! Боги, я твержу это всё время! Даже отец не слушает доводов!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.src: If I don't get freed we're doomed, you hear me?! We won't survive another war! As your prince I demand to be freed!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.dst: Если меня не освободят, нам конец, слышите?! Ещё одну войну не пережить! Как ваш принц требую свободы!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.src: Listen, the statues are climbable and there's a control panel for the lava siphons near them! Now help me so we all don't die!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.dst: Слушай, на статуи можно залезть, а рядом пульт лавовых сифонов! Помоги мне, пока мы все не погибли!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.src: Free Axelus and escape the city.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.dst: Освободи Axelus и сбеги из города.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.src: Wait, that human just defaced the hero's monument!! Are they working with the demons too?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.dst: Стой, этот человек осквернил памятник героям!! Он тоже заодно с демонами?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.src: {u}! I didn't think you'd be back, but we need to leave, now! Meet me outside!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.dst: {u}! Не думал, что ты вернёшься, но надо уходить, сейчас же! Жду снаружи!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#016.src: {u}! Over here, to the right! By the cannon! I'm commandeering this thing.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#016.dst: {u}! Сюда, направо! У пушки! Я её реквизирую.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#016.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.src: We need to get up to the Doguns before the Dwarves begin their assault, or before the Doguns take their last resort.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.dst: Надо добраться до Dogun, пока дворфы не пошли в атаку или пока Dogun не пошли на крайность.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.src: Get in the cannon, now! You've got your armour, you might end up charred and covered in soot but you'll be fine!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.dst: Лезь в пушку, живо! На тебе доспехи: обгоришь и покроешься сажей, но уцелеешь!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.src: Don't tell anyone we shot ourselves out of a cannon, I'll never live it down. Now come on, to the Dogun village, hurry!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.dst: Не говори никому, что мы выстрелили собой из пушки, мне это век не забудут. Скорее, в деревню Dogun!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.src: If the Doguns are taking their last resort and summoning Garaheth, then we've got two sides to stop at once...basically, the odds are astronomically against us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.dst: Если Dogun идут на крайность и призывают Garaheth, то останавливать придётся сразу две стороны… проще говоря, шансы против нас астрономически малы.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.src: That means you do what you need to do, no matter what. Understood? If we can stop this madness then the casualties won't have died for nothing! Now move!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.dst: Значит, делай что нужно, чего бы это ни стоило. Понял? Если остановим это безумие, погибшие умерли не зря! Вперёд!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.src: Reach the portal and stop Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.dst: Доберись до портала и останови Garaheth.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.src: Quiet. Dwarven whelp...we will not go quietly. AWAKEN.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.dst: Молчи. Щенок-дворф… мы не уйдём тихо. ПРОБУДИСЬ.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#025.src: I can't believe this... That bone was part of the ritual?! Agh, how could we have been so STUPID! You're all lucky we prepared for this!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#025.dst: Не могу поверить… Та кость была частью ритуала?! Агх, как мы могли быть такими ТУПЫМИ! Вам повезло, что мы подготовились!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#025.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#026.src: You need to get inside him. He's still chained! The amulet will protect you from the heat! Freeze him from the inside out!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#026.dst: Тебе надо попасть внутрь него. Он ещё скован! Амулет защитит от жара! Заморозь его изнутри!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#026.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.src: Find all {~} organs and destroy them.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.src: Leave Garaheth and exit his realm.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.dst: Покинь Garaheth и выйди из его владений.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#030.src: EVERYONE, STOP THIS! RIGHT NOW!! IT'S OVER!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#030.dst: ВСЕ, ПРЕКРАТИТЕ! СЕЙЧАС ЖЕ!! ВСЁ КОНЧЕНО!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#030.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#031.src: Open your eyes for once in your lives!! You see that?! Behind me! THAT was going to be the end result!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#031.dst: Хоть раз в жизни откройте глаза!! Видите?! За мной! ВОТ чем бы всё закончилось!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#031.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#032.src: Garaheth would have killed every one of us, damn it! Are you that short-sighted that you can't see this?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#032.dst: Garaheth перебил бы всех нас, чёрт возьми! Вы настолько близоруки, что не видите?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#032.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.src: Everyone here is to blame, except the human who helped stop this! The Doguns were already exiled, they wouldn't have hurt anyone!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.dst: Виноваты все здесь, кроме человека, который помог это остановить! Dogun и так были в изгнании, они никому бы не навредили!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.src: But we couldn't just let ANYTHING be! You always need more glory, more, more, MORE! Don't you, Draani? I'm ashamed to be your lineage!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.dst: Но мы не могли оставить в покое НИЧЕГО! Тебе всегда мало славы, больше, больше, БОЛЬШЕ! Да, Draani? Стыжусь быть твоим потомком!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.src: And you, Doguns! I...I pitied you. You were wronged, but you resort to this? You'd doom the world over to spite the Dwarves? Is that it?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.dst: А вы, Dogun! Я… я жалел вас. С вами обошлись несправедливо, но вы пошли на такое? Погубить мир назло дворфам? Так?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.src: Whelp. You do not understand. To be persecuted...and see your people tortured...hunted.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.dst: Щенок. Ты не понимаешь. Терпеть гонения… видеть, как твой народ пытают… травят.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.src: You all deserve it! You attacked out ancestors for sport! Eye for an eye, have you heard of it? It's only fair!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.speaker: Dwarven Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.src: Imbeciles...your stories are not true. We... We lived through the war. You took everything...and suffered none.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.dst: Глупцы… ваши истории лгут. Мы… Мы пережили ту войну. Вы забрали всё… и не пострадали.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.src: I've been trying to tell BOTH of you that the monarchy has been spreading lies for centuries! One bad king doesn't mean the whole species is a loss!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.dst: Я пытаюсь сказать ВАМ ОБОИМ, что монархия веками распространяет ложь! Один плохой король не значит, что весь народ пропащий!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.src: Shut your mouth. Even now...you trample on the bones of our god... You have taken everything from us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.dst: Закрой рот. Даже сейчас… вы попираете кости нашего бога… Вы отняли у нас всё…
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.src: This earth is stained by you. We...we shall burn you...and scatter your ash to the wind.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.dst: Вы запятнали эту землю. Мы… мы сожжём вас… и развеем ваш прах по ветру.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.src: DON'T YOU DARE! STOP, RIGHT NOW!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.src: You would... You would kill a savior...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#046.src: No, no! No no no, this can't be happening! H-Hang on, we'll save you, I...I'll do something, I...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#046.dst: Нет, нет! Нет-нет-нет, этого не может быть! Д-держись, мы тебя спасём, я… я что-нибудь сделаю, я…
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#046.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#047.src: Y-You DEMONS! MONSTERS! I'll avenge you, Axelus, j-just give me time-
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#047.dst: В-вы ДЕМОНЫ! ЧУДОВИЩА! Я отомщу за тебя, Axelus, т-только дай время—
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#047.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.src: AGH, SHUT UP! SHUT...ack... Q-Quiet. Listen to one damn word from my mouth, Draani... For once in your miserable life
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.dst: АГХ, ЗАМОЛЧИ! ЗАМОЛ…кх… Т-тихо. Послушай хоть одно моё слово, Draani… Хоть раз в своей жалкой жизни
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.src: Tell. The. TRUTH!! G-gaagh...you know that's th...the only way to stop this. Swallow your pride, you...old fool...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.dst: Скажи. Всем. ПРАВДУ!! Г-гаах… ты знаешь, это… единственный способ. Усмири гордыню, старый… дурак…
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.src: I...I... Axelus... He...he called me Draani...why did...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.dst: Я… я… Axelus… Он… он назвал меня Draani… почему…?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.src: Men, stand down. This... This war is over! I will not have one more life lost! Touch the Doguns and I'll personally behead you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.dst: Солдаты, отставить. Эта… Эта война окончена! Больше ни одной смерти! Тронете Dogun — лично обезглавлю!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.src: Chief, I...I ask of you but an hour of your time. If you are willing to negotiate...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.dst: Вождь, я… прошу у вас лишь час времени. Если вы готовы к переговорам…
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.src: Speak with the King of {p} and the Dogun Chieftain.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.dst: Поговори с королём {p} и вождём Dogun.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.src: Ah, you've arrived. I...actually remember you from earlier. So you and...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.dst: А, ты здесь. Я… вообще-то помню тебя. Значит, ты и…
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#056.src: ...you knew my son. Were helping him try to put an end to this, before everything was too far gone. Heh...apologies, for that.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#056.dst: …тебе знаком мой сын. С твоей помощью он пытался остановить это, пока не стало слишком поздно. Хех… прости за всё это.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#056.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.src: Paku and I have had a long discussion about the wisdom of youth over the old. You all were right. I needed to swallow my pride.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.dst: Мы с Paku долго говорили о мудрости молодых перед старыми. Вы все были правы. Мне нужно было усмирить гордыню.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#058.src: We agreed upon a peace treaty... A new city... The Dwarves will aid us in building it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#058.dst: Мы заключили мир… Новый город… Дворфы помогут нам его построить.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#058.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.src: All hostilities...will end. My people will...be free to roam the caverns. It has been...too long.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.dst: Вражда… закончится. Мой народ… сможет свободно бродить по пещерам. Слишком… долго мы ждали.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.src: And the entombed Doguns at Courag will be reconstituted, as well, supposing that is a possibility.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.dst: А замурованных Dogun в Courag тоже возродят, если это вообще возможно.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.src: Every king, since my so-far-great grandfather, Draani Thunderwill, has battled with their morality over the lies told to my people.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.dst: Каждый король со времён моего пра-пра-прадеда Draani Thunderwill боролся с совестью из-за лжи, сказанной народу.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.src: It ends here, with the name Draani VIII. It will take time, but the bloodshed has proven things must begin to change now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.src: You and the coalition have saved the Heights, and Gavel. In {p}, you will find a stall to trade valuable minerals. You will be granted special Dwarven privileges to purchase it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.src: Though that is...almost certainly not enough a reward for everything you have done...sincerely. Thank you, Wynn soldier.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.speaker: King of Rodoroc
